items.text: Table.to_csv(path, fields=None) was implemented on 2026-11-03 in tinydb/table.py at Finance's request (Finance repeatedly asks for CSV dumps of tables), with four new tests in tests/test_tables.py. Behavior: header row first, then one row per document; `fields` picks and orders columns and defaults to every top-level key in first-seen order; missing values become empty cells; keys not in `fields` are ignored; returns the number of documents written; UTF-8, comma delimiter, no BOM, standard quoting; nested values written via `str()`; an empty table yields a blank line without `fields` and a header only with `fields`. The full suite (236 tests) passed when run with `-c /dev/null`, because pytest.ini requires an uninstalled coverage plugin. The work is uncommitted on the `table-to-csv` branch.

Follow-up fixes in Feb 2020 covered document ID generation, `len(db)` on empty databases, doc ID conversion during updates, regex handling of non-string values and mypy compliance; queries evaluated without a test are no longer supported (breaking change).
YAML storage support is covered by tests and installable: YAML tests are ensured to run in the test suite, and PyYAML is declared as a dependency in setup.py.

TinyDB v4.0 (November 2019) was a major architecture refactor to modernize the codebase and simplify the architecture (rationale in #284, by Markus Siemens): Python 2 support removed, `ujson` support deprecated, the deprecated element ID API removed, project configuration switched to Poetry, and type annotations added. Closes #250 and #103.

Query robustness fixes in October 2026: is_sequence() now uses collections.abc.Sequence and excludes str/bytes/bytearray, so Query.any/all no longer treat strings as character lists (#641, fixes #638); regex flags are now included in the matches/search query hash, so queries differing only by flags no longer share a Table query-cache entry (#640, fixes #637).

Table.get gained a `doc_ids` parameter (feat commit 6f03ec6, May–June 2023, by Mohammad Mohtashim) allowing retrieval of multiple documents by ID, documented as `Table.get(doc_ids=[...])` (references #504, closes #486).

Query robustness fixes in October 2026: is_sequence() now uses collections.abc.Sequence and excludes str/bytes/bytearray so Query.any/all no longer treat strings as character lists (#641, fixes #638); regex flags are now included in matches/search query hash so queries differing only by flags no longer share a Table query-cache entry (#640, fixes #637). | When: 2026-10-06 | Involving: Utkarsh Adhran | Prevent incorrect matches and query-cache poisoning
